fact: The Uganda Standards Catalogue as of 31 December 2023 lists UNBS as the body declaring Uganda Standards and names US 2175:2021 Information security - Requirements for security controls, published 2021-12-14, and US ISO/IEC 27001:2013 under technical committee UNBS/TC 123 on information and communication technology.
title: Uganda Standards Catalogue as of 31 December 2023
